fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: Exercise description shown above the editor.

fields.name: starterCode
fields.label: Starter code
fields.description: Initial Python code shown in the editor.

fields.name: testCode
fields.label: Test assertions
fields.description: Python assert statements run when the student clicks Run. Leave empty for free-form exercises (completion-only, no score).

fields.name: solutionCode
fields.label: Solution code
fields.description: Shown when the student requests the solution. Only available if 'Enable solution button' is checked.

fields.name: enableSolutionsButton
fields.label: Enable "Show solution" button
fields.description: Allow students to view the solution after attempting the exercise. Disable for exam/assessment use.

fields.name: enableRetry
fields.label: Enable "Retry" button
fields.description: Allow students to reset the editor and start over.

fields.name: stepmode
fields.label: Step-by-step execution
fields.description: Run the student's code one line at a time, highlighting the current line and showing variable values. Tests still run at full speed. Needs a current browser (Chrome/Edge 137+, Firefox 153+, Safari 27+).

fields.name: showEnergy
fields.label: Show energy
fields.description: Show how many lines the code executed after each run. Counting slows execution, so leave this off for heavy computations.

fields.name: multifile
fields.label: Allow multiple files
fields.description: Show file tabs so students can add their own modules or data files.

fields.name: maxEnergy
fields.label: Maximum energy
fields.description: Maximum number of executed lines. Solutions that use more fail an extra "energy() <= N" check. Leave empty for no limit.

fields.name: maxMemory
fields.label: Maximum memory
fields.description: Maximum number of non-blank, non-comment code lines. Longer solutions fail an extra "memory() <= N" check. Leave empty for no limit.
